image_prompt.text: A unique stylized upgrade shop building fronting the town square, the storefront every player returns to for upgrades and progression purchases
Winding pink walkable paths chaining the town to the terraced hills where value is collected and on to the sell zone
Chunky purple low-poly rock barriers walling off the higher hill terraces, dropping into the ground when bought
A dedicated 'SELL ZONE' cave portal cut into the hillside, signed and lit as the place a full load is cashed in
A main town area of built-up stylized cartoon buildings at small-town density, anchored by a tall stylized city building
Terraced magenta and pink hills stepping up behind the town, studded with chunky purple low-poly rock formations
Tall stylized green pine trees across the hill terraces and the edges of the town
Modern stylized street lanterns lining the winding paths and hanging glowing lamps strung through the town

layout_placement.text: The SELL ZONE trigger volume at the cave mouth, closing the collect-and-sell loop

notes: would have asked: Sounds like a shared simulator world: one common map everybody plays in, a central upgrade shop, winding paths out to where you collect, and purchase-gated walls into the higher zones. I would add your terraced pink hills, the town itself, and the SELL ZONE cave portal on top. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: the prompt never names purchase gates; gate-progression came in with the Incremental Simulator preset because nothing contradicts it and gated hill tiers are canonical for this kind of map. Would have confirmed before shipping it.

would have asked: is the SELL ZONE cave portal a traversable tunnel or just a marked cave-mouth alcove? Read as an entrance facade, so no P2 overhang cost. A real cave network would push terrain-relief from 'P0 + tiered' to P2.

would have asked: do players go inside the upgrade shop and the city building, or buy from the street? Read as storefronts, so no P3 interiors. P3 is not ready to build today anyway; say the word and it can be noted for when it is.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
Terraced hills carry 'P0 + tiered' (stepped elevation, no overhang). Everything else in the pick set is baseline P0.

Art direction stated by the prompt and not expressible as an option: vibrant colourful cartoon aesthetic, low-poly, high-contrast smooth surfaces, magenta/pink/purple palette. Applies to every entry above.
